summary: Wrote a four-phase implementation plan for the file_scope /** containment defect. Phase 1 adds one guarded escaped-asterisk suffix-strip branch to is_contained_v10 in git-commit-scoped.sh and to its ported twin is_contained in git-commit-phase.sh (atomic-batch, both sites in one commit). Phases 2 and 3 add four Z-series cases and two Case entries to the two existing suites, each required to be observed red against pre-fix behaviour. Phase 4 redeploys via deploy-headless.sh and runs the full verify-deploy.sh gate set. Confirmed independently against specs/state.json that task 425 is disjoint, so no dependencies[] edge was added.

artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan fixing the quoted-case-pattern /** containment bug at both predicate sites, with paired test coverage and redeploy.
